## Problem

Aerial granular application calibration produces spatially detailed swath-card data, but turning those measurements into consistent, interpretable outputs can be slow and difficult to reproduce.

## Data

- Swath-card locations
- Granular counts or application-rate measurements
- Flight/application metadata
- Calibration trial design information

## Methods

- Data cleaning and QA/QC
- Spatial interpolation or profile modeling
- Swath-width and uniformity metrics
- Interactive charts and maps
- Exportable reports

## Outputs

Add screenshots or embeds here:

- Swath profile chart
- Uniformity plot
- Interactive map
- Summary table
- Example report

## Impact

Describe the operational value clearly: faster calibration review, better parameter selection, reproducible analysis, and clearer communication between field operations and technical staff.
